intro: Upload a policy or SOP (PDF, DOCX, Markdown or text). Heimdall splits it into numbered clauses and drafts three support conversations per clause: a normal case, an edge case and a customer who insists on breaking the rule. Drafts wait for your review; accepted ones become tasks, and the readiness check proves a compliant reply passes and a violating one fails.
noShape: Policy tasks are support conversations: this benchmark has no task with a simulated customer. Use a support benchmark (Benchmarks > New, template support).
reviewEmpty: No drafts to review yet. Policy drafts are made on the Policy tab of a support benchmark.
viewerNote: Policy documents and their drafts include reference replies, so only members can open them. The report is below.
